items.title: Trump says US will scale back military drills with South Korea
items.dek: His decision to reduce the partnership came after South Korea recently declined to aid his war effort in Iran.

items.title: US commander says mental health a 'priority' on USS Lincoln
items.dek: Adm Brad Cooper acknowledged that navy service at sea for long periods is "uniquely challenging and tough", following a visit to the warship.
